clips.caption:
Most people don't miss opportunities by bad luck. They miss them because of a bad self-image.

Inside you is a picture of who you think you are. Top earners see themselves as winners, as champions, as rich. Most people don't.

So when a real opportunity shows up, something quietly sabotages it — you don't take it, or you take it and quit.

Kevin Trudeau says the picture inside you has to match the goal, or you'll talk yourself out of it every time.

What's the story you tell yourself about who you are?

#kevintrudeau #selfimage #mindsetshift #successmindset #manifestation #wealthmindset

Ask someone how much money they make, and Kevin Trudeau says he can tell you their mentality before they finish the sentence.

The lowest mentality talks in hours. Then days. Then weeks. Then months.

Rich people talk in years, because their mind already operates at that level. Ask a $500,000-a-year earner what they make, and that is exactly how they answer.

The words you use about money are the mentality you are stuck in.

How do you talk about what you make?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #richmindset #moneymindset #successmindset #manifestation
